comment: The DSP is the Parasite firmware for Tides, vendored as alt_firmware/bumps; src/temulenti.cpp is the Rack wrapper. The manual says the SYNC button behaves as it does in Aestus, which would include engaging on a patched CLOCK cable; temulenti.cpp:160 reads the button alone, with no test of the CLOCK input's connected state, so only the button engages it here. The quantiser at temulenti.cpp:194 works on the whole pitch — knob plus V/OCT plus the calibration offset — before the FM amount is applied, so FM is not quantised. With the harmonic oscillator model and the C4 compatibility option switched off, temulenti.cpp:187 subtracts a further twelve semitones, which the maker's comment marks as an addition of their own rather than original behaviour. The peacocks plotter of Aestus is not present.
